@@U02221@@
with crossed halberds.
Ah, but here he is, the brazen fool!

@@U02223@@
(Kneeling at the throne.)

@@U02224@@
What is accursed yet always welcome?
What is desired yet always rejected?
What is forever being protected?
What is harshly censured and accused?
Who is it you may not summon?
Whose name is a delight to all?
What approaches the steps to your throne?
What self-banishes itself from you?

@@U02226@@
Spare us your words for now!
This is no place for riddles;
that’s these gentlemen’s affair.
Ah, but I have it!
Let them pose theirs,
and you do the solving.
Now, that I’d be curious to hear!
I fear my former Fool has gone for good.
Come! Take his place beside me!

@@U02227@@
(梅菲斯特 mounts the steps and stands at his left.)

@@U02229@@
—A new Fool.
—New troubles for us.
—Where’s he from?
—How did he get in?
—The old Fool fell.
—He’s done for.
—That one was a tub.
—This one’s a twig.

@@U02231@@
So, most dear and loyal subjects,
I welcome you from near and far!
translation:
@@U02221@@
交叉的戟。
啊，但他就在这里，厚颜无耻的傻瓜！

@@U02223@@
（跪在宝座前。）

@@U02224@@
什么是被诅咒却总是受欢迎的？
想要什么却总是被拒绝？
什么是永远被保护的？
什么是受到严厉谴责和指责的？
你不能召唤的是谁？
谁的名字让所有人都高兴？
通往你王座的台阶是什么？
是什么让你自我放逐？

@@U02226@@
现在就先别再说了！
这里不适合猜谜语。
这是这些先生们的事。
啊，但是我有！
让他们摆出自己的姿势，
然后你来解决。
现在，我很想听听！
我担心我以前的傻瓜已经永远消失了。
来！把他放在我身边吧！

@@U02227@@
（梅菲斯特走上台阶，站在他的左边。）

@@U02229@@
——一个新的傻瓜。
——给我们带来了新的麻烦。
——他是哪里人？
——他是怎么进来的？
——老愚者倒下了。
——他完蛋了。
——那个是浴缸。
——这是一根树枝。

@@U02231@@
所以，最亲爱、最忠诚的臣民，
我欢迎远近的您！
